title: Reliable update checks and a clearer menu
summary: Update checks now follow your selected schedule, recover after Mac sleep, and show a live last-checked time. The menu bar groups existing commands under Add, Widgets, and Options.
details: Hourly and other selected check intervals apply with verified automatic installation enabled.
Arras checks again after the Mac wakes and retries failed checks without excessive requests.
The last-checked time updates while Settings remains open.
Existing menu bar commands are grouped under Add, Widgets, and Options.
